facts.fact: 他一夜没睡：每次想抽身，她就哼一声往他怀里钻。
facts.anchor: But every time I thought about moving, Rosalind would make some soft little sound and burrow closer.

facts.fact: 他没动：世上没有任何一次高潮值得打扰她这份信任。
facts.anchor: There wasn't a fucking orgasm on the planet worth disturbing that.

facts.fact: 他对兄弟的内心反驳：他能温柔、小心、体贴——只是不想再吵。
facts.anchor: I could be gentle. I could be careful. Thoughtful.

facts.fact: 他的判词来源：她见过最坏的他，仍信他不会伤她。
facts.anchor: She knew exactly how easily I could hurt her. And she trusted me not to.

facts.fact: 三兄弟里只有他没开张——健身房的自嘲。
facts.anchor: Three newly mated Blackwood brothers, and somehow I was the only one not getting laid.
